failure_modes.cause: Vapour pressure of DMF exceeds pump inlet pressure at T > 120°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurise feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above vapour pressure

failure_modes.cause: Particulate matter or crystallization in DMF
failure_modes.mitigation: Install inline filter before BPR and ensure DMF is fully dissolved

failure_modes.cause: Precipitation of reaction by-products at high concentration
failure_modes.mitigation: Optimize concentration and monitor for pressure increase indicating fouling

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage stops all flow
validation_experiments: Run blank DMF at Q=0.09817 mL/min for 60 min; monitor pressure for drift > 5%
Conduct particle size analysis on DMF feed to ensure no particulates > 10 microns
Perform long-term stability test at 120°C to check for precipitation or fouling
